name: Streaming and Level-of-Detail (LOD) selection
definition: Streaming scene data using additive ladders in prefix order, selecting coarsest substitutive level based on projected splat footprint.
summary: Streaming and Level-of-Detail selection visualizes massive scenes by dynamically selecting data resolution based on viewpoint and screen footprint, distinguishing itself through a level-of-detail grammar that prioritizes visual coverage preservation during streaming.
